title: Under pressure: How HPP technology helps food processors extend shelf life, protect quality, and grow businesses
summary: Food processors are under pressure to deliver safer, fresher products with longer shelf life, less waste, and fewer compromises on quality. High Pressure Processing (HPP) helps them overcome these pressures and grow their businesses. On 5 November, JBT Marel attended Pure Food Tech UK HPP Innovation Summit.
body_markdown:
The[Summit](https://purefoodtech.com/) brought together food producers, processors, equipment manufacturers, and partners to explore the potential applications of High Pressure Processing for food safety, chilled shelf life, and product development. Sessions covered:


-


HPP as a business case


-


Packaging and closures suitable for HPP treatment


-


New trends and emerging applications in High Pressure Processing


-


Road-mapping HPP product development


Throughout the day, experts exchanged knowledge and ideas on current and future opportunities for using high pressure processing technology across seafood, sauces, soups and dips, fresh pet nutrition, prepared meals, and beverages.


##### Turning the evidence into opportunity


Jasper van Altena presented on behalf of JBT Marel, focusing on trends and emerging applications. He set out the evidence behind HPP’s benefits for food safety, shelf life, and product quality compared to thermal preservation techniques, before diving into the uses of HPP in food preservation; an area of interest for everyone at the event.


##### How JBT Marel supports customers


Seeing the potential of HPP is one thing; turning it into a viable, profitable operation is another. JBT Marel works alongside processors at every step, from assessing if HPP fits a product, to considering packaging and closures. Our HPP solutions are built on over 40 years of experience developing this exciting technology to help customers achieve longer shelf life, safer products, and consistent quality, while supporting more sustainable food production.


It was an engaging day with new connections made and imaginations captured by the future possibilities of this emerging technology. We can’t wait to continue working with our customers to develop the technology to support global food security through safer food and sustainable preservation techniques.


See[how our HPP solutions meet the new EU Listeria standards](https://jbtmarel.com/en/news/avure-hpp-easily-meets-the-new-eu-listeria-standards/) .


##### What is HPP?


High Pressure Processing is a non-thermal preservation technology. Packaged food is placed in a sealed chamber and exposed to very high pressure transmitted through water; effectively preserving food while maintaining nutritional value and organoleptic attributes.
